description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Assault Mode] and [Dual Blink 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Assault Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, casts Rush Blade after using a Spellblade ability, removed upon taking damage

description.name: Dual Blink 2
description.text: Evades the next 2 attacks that could be evaded with [Physical Blink] or [Magical Blink], lower priority than [Physical Blink] and [Magical Blink]
